scenes.title: The Wrong Wake?
scenes.summary: Two grieving family members think they walked into the wrong wake until the funeral organizer proudly explains she microbladed their mother's eyebrows.

scenes.title: You Have to Die Gorgeous
scenes.summary: The organizer explains the chapel's motto of dying gorgeous and claims she gave the deceased a facelift so she would not have to return in six months.

scenes.title: Included in the Package
scenes.summary: The organizer assures the family that the swelling will subside in three months and demonstrates that the matte foundation does not smudge.

scenes.title: Keep the Lip Filler
scenes.summary: The organizer offers to wipe off the makeup but defends the lip filler and orthodontic aligners, tempting one of the mourners into asking for a touch-up.

scenes.title: Makeup to Wake the Dead
scenes.summary: In the closing tag, a presenter films an upbeat makeup tutorial promising a look that could wake the dead.
